responsibility: Implements LRA’s rematerialization subpass for spilled pseudos. It discovers candidate defining insns whose values can be cheaply recomputed rather than reloaded from memory, performs local and global availability analysis for those candidates across basic blocks, and replaces eligible reload uses with newly emitted rematerialization insns when register and clobber constraints allow. This file is specifically about available-expression style rematerialization of spill values, not general spill-slot assignment or constraint fixing.
